text:
harper_sales: Prospect NovaLedger wants a POC: dual HSM (us-east/us-west), weekly rotation @ 22:00 PST, zero-exposure of unwrapped keys, and they insist on "vendor Shamir" in questionnaire. Can we support?
noah_se: Short: we accept BYO keys via proxy and will consume wrapped key blobs. We do NOT perform vendor-side Shamir. Customer must split client-side or use partner in their network. We can document partner flow and accept wrapped shares.
noah_se: POC proxy example:
```
proxy_mode: accept-wrapped
hsm_targets: [hsm-east:1234, hsm-west:1234]
validate_wrapped: true
rotation_schedule: weekly@22:00-PST
```
isabel_security: Security must sign off: 1) require HSM vendor attestation (FIPS cert + module ID). 2) Logs must never contain unwrapped key material; only hashed digests allowed. 3) Retention >12 months needs SOC2 addendum (customer asked 14 months).
jess_sre: Perf note: cross-region HSM adds ~8-15ms median; synchronous dual-sign multiplies tail latency. For POC we recommend simulated HSMs first then one region real test. Onboarding checklist minimal:
- allowlist proxy egress IPs
- upload HSM cert chain to console
- provide wrapped key blobs + test vectors
- run rotation dry-run at scheduled window
release-bot: deploy: byo-hsm-proxy-v2.1 -> https://ci.redwood/build/6789
harper_sales: Pricing ask: they want per-sign pricing for audit. Proposal: reserved proxy node + tiered per-1M sign ops, plus optional "chaos/failover" test as billable add-on. Use 3M ops/day for quote baseline.
isabel_security: I'll assemble the vendor cert checklist and approved Shamir client libs for them. Note: we must state "no vendor Shamir" in SOW and include partner-run integration as an explicit integration path.
joah_se: I'll produce a 2-week POC SOW: acceptance criteria = dual-sign failover, rotation dry-run at 22:00 PST with zero-key-exposure, audit logs shipped as digests, latency within SLO. Include partner split option and cost appendix.
harper_sales: Great. I'll update RFQ and send. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
